segments.text: [Music]
hey guys i just want to show you a quick
and super helpful python tip where you
can play around and test your code it
can also be used for debugging and to
find your errors
so the tip i want to show you is the
python interactive mode
so you can run any python script with
the
minus i flag and this runs the whole
file
but at the end it will not exit the
program but instead it opens an
interactive session where you can play
around with the code
so here i'm in the terminal and if i
just say
python myscript.pi
then it runs the code so it prints three
in this case but then it exits the
program
and now if i say python minus
i myscript.pi then you see it also
runs the script so it prints three but
now here we have this interactive
session
and here you can play around with the
code so here we have
access to all of the variables for
example
and all of the functions and objects
so again i can print
a and this variable i can also
run the function again and see what this
is doing
or i have access to this object so i can
print the object
and the variable inside this object so
this is five i can also change the code
so i can say
o dot var equals seven
and now if i print this again then we
see this is seven
so yeah this is a really nice way to
play around with the code and to test
all of the functions
and then when you're done you can simply
print
quit and now this will exit the python
program so now we are in the terminal
again
and yeah this is all i wanted to show
you i hope you enjoyed this quick
tutorial and please hit the like button
and consider subscribing to the channel
and see you in the next video bye
